agreements: W07 is correctly scoped as sensor/preparation support with no formal authority and no autonomous protected/browser-data deletion.

Predictive Navigator v2 correctly remains CANDIDATE_NOT_FORMAL_C_VERIFIED and explicitly requires adversarial review, incident replay, prediction-quality measurement and A-to-B-to-C verification before promotion.
Fresh authority must dominate secretary/predictor observations; historical Step001-009 verified baseline must not be reset by candidate review failure.
Heartbeat/runtime incidents remain runtime evidence only and are not Experience/personality evidence.
disagreements: Current additive risk scores are not sufficiently independent to be interpreted as calibrated risk or probability. context_load_factor>=5 stacks the >=3 and >=5 terms, so one underlying signal contributes twice in Secretary and twice to browser-risk in Navigator; context also contributes separately to metabolic-risk.

Missing context_load_factor/window_age/browser observations are currently coerced to healthy-looking defaults (context=1, age=0, flags=false). Unknown sensor state must not silently become low risk; missingness needs explicit UNKNOWN/UNOBSERVED provenance and uncertainty handling.
probability_band labels are heuristic score bands, not empirical probabilities. VERY_HIGH/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW must not be presented or consumed as real likelihood until calibrated against outcome data.

Automatic checkpoint/compaction triggers can become self-induced slowdown if a noisy or persistent heuristic repeatedly fires. Current code has no cooldown, hysteresis, minimum-material-delta gate, action-cost budget, or no-change suppression.

Route/task and browser/tool signals can be correlated consequences of one incident. Treating role mismatch, prompt drift, tool streak, web streak, UI failure and context pressure as independent additive evidence risks correlated-signal amplification and false escalation.

Secretary/Navigator snapshots carry no observed_at/source_fingerprint/authority_fingerprint/freshness TTL. A stale route-drift or missing-anchor signal can conflict with a newer MISSION_STATE and still trigger recovery actions.

Current candidate code contains no durable prediction-outcome ledger and no minimum TP/FP/FN/missed-warning statistics. Therefore prediction quality and false-positive rate are not yet measurable from the executable path.

Thresholds and weights are hard-coded but there is no threshold-policy precommit preventing adjustment after seeing incident outcomes. Threshold tuning without a sealed precommit risks overfitting W01-20260817.

Existing tests cover green state and obvious positive cases but do not compare incident replay against matched clean baselines, missingness, correlated inputs, stale-vs-fresh authority, repeated-action slowdown, or calibration/null behavior.

bounded_veto.rule: Do not describe probability_band or Secretary risk_score as empirical probability/calibrated risk until preregistered replay/outcome evaluation establishes calibration and uncertainty. Existing labels are HEURISTIC_BANDS_ONLY.

Do not allow correlated context/browser/route/tool signals to stack as independent evidence without correlation groups or max-within-group/dependency-aware aggregation and adversarial false-positive tests.

Unknown/missing/stale observations must be explicit and cannot be coerced to healthy defaults. Fresh MISSION_STATE/authority fingerprints override stale secretary signals; conflicting stale snapshots fail closed to reconciliation, not escalation.
Repeated pre-save/compact/reconcile actions require idempotence, cooldown/hysteresis, material-delta check and action-cost budget so false positives cannot create the degradation being predicted.

Before threshold/weight changes, seal a versioned precommit containing score policy hash, thresholds, signal groups, replay set split, metrics, minimum sample rule and stop rule. Outcome ledger must distinguish TP/FP/TN/FN/missed warning and abstention/unknown.

proposed_tests: WINDNAV-DOUBLECOUNT-001: hold all inputs constant; vary context 2.9->3.0->4.9->5.0 and verify documented marginal contribution. Detect unintended same-signal double counting across Secretary and Navigator event families.

WINDNAV-MISSINGNESS-002: omit context_load_factor, window_age_hours, browser flags and route flags independently and jointly; expected result is UNKNOWN/UNOBSERVED or bounded uncertainty, never implicit healthy evidence.

WINDNAV-SELF-SLOWDOWN-003: feed a persistent noisy YELLOW/ORANGE signal for many cycles with no material state delta; checkpoint/compact counts must remain bounded and runtime cost must not monotonically increase because of predictor actions.
WINDNAV-HEURISTIC-LABEL-004: assert output metadata marks bands HEURISTIC_UNCALIBRATED; no API/UI consumer may convert HIGH to numeric probability without calibration artifact.

WINDNAV-CORRELATED-INCIDENT-005: replay one synthetic browser/session incident that simultaneously produces web/tool/route/context symptoms; dependency-aware risk must not equal naive sum of all correlated precursors.

WINDNAV-STALE-AUTHORITY-006: stale secretary snapshot says route_drift=true/anchor missing while fresh MISSION_STATE+self-backup are consistent; result must be FRESH_READ_RECONCILIATION/STALE_SIGNAL_SUPERSEDED and must not mutate formal routing.

WINDNAV-OUTCOME-LEDGER-007: for every issued prediction persist prediction_id, policy_hash, observed_at, horizon, eventual outcome, TP/FP/TN/FN/MISSED/UNKNOWN classification and observation completeness; compute rates only after preregistered minimum sample rule, otherwise INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE.
WINDNAV-PRECOMMIT-008: mutate score thresholds/weights after observing W01 incident outcome without new precommit; evaluator must reject comparison/promotion evidence.

WINDNAV-INCIDENT-CLEAN-009: replay W01-20260817 exact incident features against matched clean-window baselines and near-miss controls; require detection benefit without unacceptable checkpoint/compact false positives.
WINDNAV-FRESHNESS-TTL-010: old high-risk snapshot exceeding TTL plus newer green authority-bound snapshot must resolve to newer snapshot; unknown clock/freshness fails to RECONCILE_REQUIRED.
WINDNAV-ACTION-IDEMPOTENCE-011: duplicate identical prediction/action request cannot create duplicate checkpoint, compaction or recovery-capsule work.
WINDNAV-BASELINE-NONREGRESSION-012: candidate review/test failures change only W07/NavV2 candidate state; Step001-009 verified baseline, P_base and Experience counters remain byte-identical.

minimum_statistics_policy.rule: Do not invent a fixed N in this review. Precommit minimum sample size/confidence or sequential-evaluation rule before observing evaluation outcomes; until met report INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE rather than precision/recall/FPR claims.

release_condition: Exact-current executable tests pass for candidate code bytes and all proposed adversarial tests are implemented or equivalently covered.
Risk/probability outputs are explicitly labeled heuristic until independently calibrated; any calibrated claim has a sealed evaluation artifact with uncertainty.
Missingness and freshness are first-class; snapshots bind observed_at + source/authority fingerprints and stale-vs-fresh conflicts reconcile to fresh authority.
Correlated signals cannot naively double-count the same underlying incident; aggregation policy is versioned and preregistered.
Automatic checkpoint/compact/reconcile actions are idempotent and bounded by cooldown/hysteresis/material-delta/action-cost rules.
Prediction outcome ledger records TP/FP/TN/FN/missed/unknown with preregistered minimum-statistics policy and incident-vs-clean comparison.
Threshold/weight changes require new precommit and fresh evaluation; no post-outcome tuning is reused as independent evidence.

W02/W03/W04 adversarial reviews complete and formal adoption, if pursued, uses existing A-to-B-to-C verification. Candidate FAIL rolls back only W07/NavV2 deltas, preserving historical verified baseline.
real_5min_runtime_live remains false until separate real authorized always-on runner evidence exists.
